name: Apartment Laura Lorenz
beschreibung: Apartment Laura Lorenz is a holiday apartment located in Galtür in the Paznaun Valley. Situated on the outskirts of the village, it offers a peaceful setting. Designed for two to four guests, the apartment features a fully equipped kitchen, a bedroom, and a bathroom. A balcony with mountain views is also available. In summer, the area is ideal for hiking and mountain biking, while the Silvretta Montafon ski area is nearby in winter. Guests appreciate the apartment as a convenient base for exploring the region. The interior is practical and tailored to the needs of self-catering travelers.
